transitions.event: CONNECT packet with Clean Start flag set to 1
transitions.action: Broker sets Session Present flag to 0 in CONNACK

transitions.event: CONNECT packet with Clean Start flag set to 0 and associated Client Identifier
transitions.action: Broker resumes communications based on existing Session state and sets Session Present flag to 1 in CONNACK

transitions.event: CONNECT packet with Clean Start flag set to 0 but no associated Client Identifier
transitions.action: Broker creates a new Session and sets Session Present flag to 0 in CONNACK

transitions.event: Client Identifier collision (new Client connects with same ID)
transitions.action: Broker sends DISCONNECT packet with reason code 0x8E (Session taken over) and closes connection to existing Client

transitions.event: Token expiration detected on CONNECT, PUBLISH, SUBSCRIBE, or PINGREQ
transitions.action: Send PUBACK, SUBACK, or DISCONNECT with reason code 'Not authorized'; close Network Connection
Send AUTH packet with reason code 0x19 (Reauthentication), Authentication Method 'ace', and new token in Authentication Data using challenge-response PoP
Accept if Client previously submitted a token with proof of possession; otherwise deny
Send DISCONNECT packet with reason code 0x87 (Not Authorized)

transitions.event: Client DISCONNECT with Session Expiry Interval set to 0
transitions.action: Broker doesn't store the Session State but MUST keep the retained messages
Broker creates a new Session and sets Session Present flag to 0 in CONNACK
Broker resumes communications based on current Session state and sets Session Present flag to 1 in CONNACK

transitions.event: CONNECT with Clean flag = 0 and no associated Session
transitions.action: Broker creates a new Session and sets Session Present flag to 0 in CONNACK
Broker ignores PUBLISH packet and disconnects Client

transitions.event: Broker-Client PUBLISH authorization failure due to expired token

transitions.action: Send AUTH packet with reason code 0x18 (Continue Authentication) containing 8-byte RS nonce

transitions.event: AUTH packet with Client Nonce and MAC/Signature
transitions.action: Validate token and signature; Send CONNACK packet with reason code 0x00 (Success)

transitions.event: CONNECT with Authentication Data (token + MAC/Signature over TLS exporter)
transitions.action: Validate token and signature; Send CONNACK packet with appropriate response code

transitions.event: AUTH packet with reason code 0x19 (Reauthentication) containing new token
transitions.action: Validate new token and signature; Send CONNACK or DISCONNECT based on validation
Send PUBACK, SUBACK, or DISCONNECT packet with reason code 0x87 (Not authorized)
